adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Right hand holds the Nagabetha (stick); left hand holds the Pillangovi (flute) or Damaru.
movement_profile.footwork: Rhythmic stepping to activate anklets; moving in circles.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Straight lines for 10-12 people, transitioning into circular paths.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Transitions from standing to lying flat on the stomach.
movement_profile.partnering: None; group synchronization led by a senior member.
movement_profile.posture: Upright during public circles; lying flat on the stomach during specific ritual segments.

signature_moves.description: Lying flat on the stomach to eat ritual offerings without using hands.
signature_moves.name: Ogu Seve Eating

signature_moves.description: Making big eyes and raised eyebrows to create a sense of awe or fear.
signature_moves.name: Scary Gaze

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid touching ritual offerings with hands during the Mane Seve; avoid breaking the 'scary' facial expression during performance.

music_profile.musical_form: Continuous storytelling/epic recitation that can last for days.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Intoxicating beats of the Damaru synchronized with heavy anklet strikes.
music_profile.sound_description: A dense percussive layer of small drums and heavy metal anklets overlaid with high-pitched flute melodies and deep, repetitive vocal chanting of religious epics.
music_profile.vocal_style: Recitation of epics and singing praises; repetition of Paraks (chants).

basic_steps: Initiate the rhythm by beating the Damaru drum in the left hand.
Play the Pillangovi (flute) while maintaining the drum rhythm.
Step in a circular path with heavy footfalls to sound the Gante (anklets).
Widen the eyes and raise eyebrows to maintain the 'scary' ritual expression.
Brandish the Nagabetha (wooden stick) while moving in the circle.
teaching.formation: Straight lines transitioning into circular movements.
teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical stamina for continuous chanting and drumming; the 'Mane Seve' version requires the ability to transition to the floor.
teaching.rhythm: Intoxicating, repetitive beats driven by the Damaru and rhythmic anklets.
